ai.rationale: PulseLens Live is a sharp, recognizably sports project: a real-time subtitle-to-insight companion for solo sports-stream viewers, with a concrete feature set (scene understanding, breaking-news summaries, explainable term highlights, and timeline-grounded Q&A). The strongest signal is its AI-native shape — subtitle summarization plus grounded Q&A is genuine LLM leverage, not a bolt-on — and it ships with both a public repo and a live deployed URL. The main weakness is the missing explainer video, which leaves the completeness picture short of the all-URLs bar; otherwise the pitch is well-scoped and ambitious for a 2-hour build.
